fullPassage: Dear Ms. Palmer, My name is Karen Whitfield, a marketing assistant in the marketing department. As part of my efforts to contribute more to the department, I would like to receive additional training to further develop my skills. Over the last quarter, I noticed our department needs to better attract potential customers for our products online. For this reason, I'm requesting that the company cover part of my training cost. I have recently searched for training courses and found Smart Growth Training's two-week course that focuses on digital marketing strategies. It costs $1,600, and I strongly believe it would be helpful for my current work. I hope you will consider my request positively. Sincerely, Karen Whitfield
title: Request for Training Support
